browserChecks.name: Barry Prison: Parkour Escape
browserChecks.result: Direct inner game timed out waiting for its bridge. Official game-only export wrapper stalled during provider verification. Excluded this and the other 15 games requiring the same provider startup.

saveScope: Uses existing per-provider browser localStorage/IndexedDB through the isolated runner and stable game URLs. No account sync or generic mid-frame snapshots. Progress requires the individual game to support saves.

validation.automatedTests: 539 passed before provider exclusions. All 5 final focused catalog/transport checks passed after exclusions.
validation.resources: 75 direct game documents and 200 referenced scripts checked; optional Facebook Instant script returned 500 and the shared onlagged helper returned 406. Native gameplay save behavior requires separate checks.

limits: Source documents and referenced scripts were checked for all additions. Browser gameplay checks are samples; every game has not been played through or individually verified for saved level progression. The existing browser storage and stable addresses are retained.
